title: Dutch Red Potato Hash
description: A crispy and flavorful side dish made with pan-fried red potatoes, inspired by traditional Dutch cuisine.
instructions: Peel the red potatoes and chop them into 1/2-inch cubes.
Heat the velvety oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the potato cubes to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they're golden brown.
Season the potatoes with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Dutch red potato hash hot.
